title: Leads pipeline board: a drag-and-drop board by status on the Leads page, with filters, per-column loading, a keyboard alternative and the lost-reason dialog
goal: Staff switch the Leads page between list and board, see each pipeline stage as a column with counts and values, and move a lead by dragging or with 'Move to…'.
why: Gap 9: leads.kanban is 'partial' in docs/features.json; the page has no board at all (checked 2026-10-21), only tasks have one. Design: TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 4.7 and 13.2.

edit: backend/src/routes/leads.ts (GET /board and the leads.board setting only)

steps: GET /leads/board with the list's filters (status set, priority, owner, source, destination, date range, q, unassigned): {columns: [{status, count, value (sum of estimated_value or budget in the agency currency; leads in other currencies counted, not summed, with a flag), leads: first 20 in the list's default order}]}; one query per column at most, no N+1 for owners.
Columns follow the leads.board setting (design 4.7; GET/PUT /leads/board-settings, admin and sales_manager), default every pipeline status in order with on_hold hidden.
Column 'load more' uses the existing GET /leads?status=&cursor=.
Leads page: List / Board toggle (remembered in localStorage per user, wrapped in try/catch); the FilterBar drives both views.

lead-board.tsx on kanban-board.tsx (extend it with drop targets and an optional per-column footer; do not copy it): columns with count and value (locale money), cards (lead-card.tsx: title, contact, destination, travel date, value, owner avatar, priority, a seats chip when the lead has a seat booking and the departures feature is on), hover actions (Open, Assign, Add follow-up), skeleton columns, empty column state, per-column Load more.
Drag and drop with HTML5 events; 'Move to…' menu on each card (keyboard and screen readers) doing the same move.

Moves are optimistic with rollback and a toast on failure; dropping on Lost opens the existing lost-reason dialog (cancel = no move); dropping on Won asks for confirmation; the status change goes through the existing status endpoint so automations run as today.
docs/features.json: leads.kanban -> works with e2e/leads-board.spec.ts as evidence.

tests: backend/test/leads-board.test.ts: counts and values per column with filters; mixed currencies flagged; settings hide a column; salesperson sees only what the list shows them (same visibility rules as GET /leads).
desktop vitest: lib/lead-board.ts (optimistic move and rollback reducer, column value formatting).

e2e/leads-board.spec.ts: switch to Board, drag a lead from New to Contacted (Playwright dragTo), move another with 'Move to…' by keyboard, drop one on Lost and give a reason, filter by priority, Load more in a long column; the list view still works.
acceptance: A pipeline board with drag and drop and a keyboard alternative exists on the Leads page; status changes made there behave exactly like those made on the lead page.
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # 0 failed files; passed >= the count at the last merge
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # 0 failing files; passed >= the count at the last merge
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3120 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8807/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/leads-board.spec.ts e2e/leads.spec.ts e2e/tasks.spec.ts
productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere.
No new feature key: the board is a view of the Leads page available on every plan.

Desktop: CONTRACT.md (FilterBar, skeletons, empty states, hover actions); t() with en and nl keys in pipeline.json and ui.json; RTL-safe classes (columns flow with the reading direction); money and dates through lib/format.ts and lib/dates.ts; localStorage access wrapped in try/catch.
kanban-board.tsx stays in the i18n-check scope and keeps the tasks board working (tasks e2e).
Never weaken, skip or delete an existing test.
